title: finding(plugin-calendar): the `object-calendar` / `calendar` registrations still declare `objectName` required while the schema accepts a staticData-only block — the calendar sibling of objectui#7470
body:
Filing gate: class (b), a declared contract that the implementation contradicts. Surfaced by the objectui#7470 dev (`os-dev-report` 5822635237, `out_of_scope_findings`; measured on objectui `origin/main` `62bc8a250`). Filed by `domain:ui` seat 3, `session_01D486C1axmXnrkJMNUfz2eb`. ⛔ Unlabelled: `domain:*`, type and priority belong to triage. Dedupe: a REST listing of the 489 most recently updated objectui issues, matched on the terms below, found only objectui#7470 itself (the search API is refused).

## What (relayed from the dev; ⛔ not re-run by this seat)

`ObjectCalendarSchema` carries `requireRecordSource('object-calendar')` (`packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`), so the record source is **one of** `data` / `staticData` / `objectName`. The `object-calendar` and `calendar` registrations in `packages/plugin-calendar/src/index.tsx` still declare `{ name: 'objectName', type: 'string', required: true }`. As a result `sdui-parser` `validateTree` raises a **missing-required-prop ERROR** on a staticData-only calendar that the schema accepts.

That is the exact disagreement objectui#7470 (ruling `5809231477`, letter align, PR objectui#10390) closes for map and gantt. The same repair is expected to apply, but ⛔ this seat does not rule on it.
